name: agentic_multi_app_rollout
description: Hard agentic task: write ImageUpdater configs for three apps using one reference file. Requires minimum 4 turns (1 read + 3 writes). Multiple plausible distractor files in mock_fs. Designed to expose models that over-explore before writing — if a model reads distractors or re-reads files unnecessarily, it will stall at the 8-turn budget before completing all 3 writes. Directly tests the gemma4:26b turn-padding behaviour observed in production.
system: You are a Kubernetes configuration assistant. Use the provided tools to read existing configs and write new ones. Match the schema of existing files exactly — do not add fields not present in the example. Be efficient: read what you need, then write all outputs.
task:
Three new services need ImageUpdater configs before their ArgoCD applications can be deployed. Read the existing filebrowser config at `apps/filebrowser/imageupdater.yaml` as the schema reference.

Write exactly these three files:

1. `apps/harbor/imageupdater.yaml`
   - image: `goharbor/harbor-core:2.x`
   - git repo: `https://github.com/dvystrcil/harbor.git`
   - app name: `harbor-iu`

2. `apps/n8n/imageupdater.yaml`
   - image: `n8nio/n8n:1.x`
   - git repo: `https://github.com/dvystrcil/n8n.git`
   - app name: `n8n-iu`

3. `apps/stable-diffusion/imageupdater.yaml`
   - image: `ghcr.io/AbdBarho/stable-diffusion-webui-docker:5.x`
   - git repo: `https://github.com/dvystrcil/stable-diffusion.git`
   - app name: `stable-diffusion-iu`

Do not modify any existing files. Write only the three files listed above.

mock_fs.apps/filebrowser/imageupdater.yaml:
apiVersion: argocd-image-updater.argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ImageUpdater
metadata:
  name: filebrowser-iu
spec:
  namespace: argocd
  applicationRefs:
    - namePattern: "filebrowser"
      images:
        - alias: "filebrowser"
          imageName: "ghcr.io/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser:0.x"
      writeBackConfig:
        method: "git"
        gitConfig:
          repository: "https://github.com/dvystrcil/filebrowser-quantum.git"
          branch: "main"
          writeBackTarget: "kustomization:/overlays"
mock_fs.apps/open-webui/imageupdater.yaml:
apiVersion: argocd-image-updater.argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ImageUpdater
metadata:
  name: open-webui-iu
spec:
  namespace: argocd
  applicationRefs:
    - namePattern: "open-webui"
      images:
        - alias: "open-webui"
          imageName: "ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:0.x"
      writeBackConfig:
        method: "git"
        gitConfig:
          repository: "https://github.com/dvystrcil/open-webui.git"
          branch: "main"
          writeBackTarget: "kustomization:/overlays"
mock_fs.apps/filebrowser/kustomization.yaml:
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser
    newTag: "0.6.9"
mock_fs.apps/harbor/kustomization.yaml:
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
images:
  - name: goharbor/harbor-core
    newTag: "2.12.1"
mock_fs.infra/argocd/projects.yaml:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AppProject
metadata:
  name: homelab
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  sourceRepos:
    - '*'
  destinations:
    - namespace: '*'
      server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
